Sri K. Jyothi Prasad, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that petitioner
has not been utilizing the la

. 
Sri Kasa Jagan Mohan Reddy, learned standing counsel for respondent No.2 would submit that the authorities are not restraining the petitioner from cultivating the land since the land is agricultural land.
In fact, in the counter affidavit, it was stated that the land remains as agricultural land until it is acquired and petitioner is not prevented from enjoying his rights over the land.
He would further submit that unless the Government permits, the CRDA being requisition authority, cannot acquire the land under L.A. Act, 2013.
In view of the above submissions, since petitioner is not prevented from utilizing the land and there is no dispute qua the ownership, petitioner is at liberty to cultivate the land.
